name: Paperclip Control Plane — fix embedded Postgres startup (root EACCES)
detail: Paperclip (control plane for AI-agent companies, fork of HenkDz/paperclip) can't start. `pnpm dev` crashes at embedded Postgres init. ROOT CAUSE: three-way conflict. (1) embedded-postgres refuses to run as root. (2) `createPostgresUser: true` (added to migration-runtime.ts) makes it spawn initdb as OS user 'postgres', but (3) the Postgres binary + repo live under /root (mode 700), which the postgres user cannot traverse -> EACCES spawning initdb even though pgdata relocated to /var/lib/paperclip/db (postgres-writable). Fix options: (A) run Paperclip under a dedicated non-root systemd user with repo+binaries relocated outside /root, (B) use PGlite (embedded, no separate postgres binary) instead of embedded-postgres, or (C) relax /root traversal for postgres (least secure, not preferred). Recommended: (B) PGlite in dev per AGENTS.md 'use embedded PGlite by leaving DATABASE_URL unset' — investigate why it falls back to embedded-postgres instead. Status: infra setup task, not a code bug in our logic. Added Aug 3 2026 (Jordan GO: map out fix).
note: [Jordan GO Aug 3: add to build list to map out fix]. Paperclip fork at /root/paperclip-fork. Also needs genTech-shop plugin once running (queue #13). Repo not pushed to GitHub yet.
